overview.problem_context: The GRN Approval page and Supplier Portal pages currently use inconsistent visual styles (generic SaaS bright blue #0076CC, borderless tables, loose card paddings, soft rounded corners, unaligned font hierarchies) that break continuity with the rest of Materials Hub (BOM Explorer, Production Plan, Stock Transfer, Purchase Order).
overview.target_visual_identity: Compact, dense, high-clarity JD Edwards / Oracle Enterprise ERP look: grid-bordered dense tables with #EAECF0 headers, zebra striping (#FFFFFF / #F9FAFB), deep enterprise blue primary actions (#004B87), IBM Plex Sans for body/labels, Chivo for headings, JetBrains Mono for data/codes/amounts, and sharp structural radii (rounded-sm throughout).

scale.section_title: font-heading text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#344054]
scale.card_title: font-heading text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#475467]
scale.table_header: font-heading text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-[#344054]

rules: Use font-heading (Chivo) for all page headers, section labels, card titles, and table column headers.
Use font-data (JetBrains Mono) for all PO numbers, Document Codes (e.g. 6-char shipment codes), Vendor Codes, Quantities, Prices, and Dates.
Use font-sans (IBM Plex Sans) for standard body copy, field descriptions, and notifications.
Never use Inter or generic system sans for headings or tabular data.

visual enhancers.borders: Solid 1px #D0D5DD grid lines on all card containers, tables, and input controls.
visual enhancers.border_radius: Strict rounded-sm (2px/4px) across all buttons, inputs, badges, cards, and modal dialogs. Never use rounded-full for buttons or status badges.
visual enhancers.shadows: Utilitarian ERP style: shadow-[0_1px_2px_0_rgba(16,24,40,0.05)] or flat border definition without heavy drop-shadows.
visual enhancers.tables: Full border-collapse with vertical and horizontal cell grid lines (border border-[#D0D5DD]). Sticky table headers with #EAECF0 background.

GrnApprovalPage.jsx.purpose: Internal admin page for GRN shipment code lookup, line-item verification, actual quantity entry, site/warehouse derivation, and SAP receipt posting.
GrnApprovalPage.jsx.layout_guideline: Full width responsive layout matching BomExplorerPage (h-screen flex flex-col overflow-hidden bg-[#F2F4F7]). Includes standard Teal Header (#0E7C86) with NavTabs and SapConnectionStatus.
GrnApprovalPage.jsx.toolbar_guideline: Sub-header toolbar container in bg-white border-b border-[#D0D5DD] p-2.5 flex items-center gap-3. Code lookup input h-8 w-64 text-[13px] font-data rounded-sm border-[#D0D5DD]. Primary Lookup button bg-[#004B87] h-8.
GrnApprovalPage.jsx.tables_guideline: Pending and detail tables must use border-collapse w-full text-[13px], thead th with bg-[#EAECF0] border border-[#D0D5DD] p-1.5 font-heading text-xs uppercase text-[#344054], tbody tr with zebra striping (even: bg-white, odd: bg-[#F9FAFB], hover: bg-[#F0F4F8]), tbody td with border border-[#D0D5DD] px-2 py-1.
GrnApprovalPage.jsx.actions_guideline: Approve & Post button: bg-[#027A48] hover:bg-[#02623A] rounded-sm h-8 text-[13px] font-bold text-white. Reject button: bg-[#B42318] hover:bg-[#912018] rounded-sm h-8 text-[13px]. Mark Discrepancy button: bg-[#B54708] hover:bg-[#93370D] rounded-sm h-8 text-[13px].

SupplierDashboardPage.jsx.purpose: External vendor dashboard for open PO viewing, entity selection (RI/RT), cart line item selection, and shipment code generation.
SupplierDashboardPage.jsx.layout_guideline: Background bg-[#F2F4F7]. Header bar in bg-[#0E7C86] with Buildings icon, title 'Supplier Portal', entity dropdown, vendor info, and Sign Out button.
SupplierDashboardPage.jsx.tables_guideline: Open PO data table in bg-white border border-[#D0D5DD] rounded-sm overflow-x-auto. Header row with bg-[#EAECF0] border border-[#D0D5DD] p-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-[#344054] font-heading uppercase. Zebra rows. PO Numbers, Qtys, Prices, and Dates formatted in font-data (JetBrains Mono).
SupplierDashboardPage.jsx.entity_switcher: Muted enterprise entity pills: selected bg-[#004B87] text-white border-[#004B87] rounded-sm, unselected bg-white border-[#D0D5DD] text-[#344054] hover:bg-[#F9FAFB].
SupplierDashboardPage.jsx.bottom_cart_bar: Fixed bottom bar in bg-white border-t border-[#D0D5DD] shadow-[0_-2px_8px_0_rgba(16,24,40,0.08)] px-4 py-3. Primary Review button bg-[#004B87] hover:bg-[#003A6A] rounded-sm.

SupplierShipmentsPage.jsx.purpose: External vendor shipment tracking and in-place edit dialog.
SupplierShipmentsPage.jsx.layout_guideline: Background bg-[#F2F4F7]. Header in bg-[#0E7C86]. Page title font-heading text-xl font-bold text-[#1D2939]. Filter controls in bg-white border border-[#D0D5DD] rounded-sm p-2.5.
SupplierShipmentsPage.jsx.tables_guideline: Shipments table in bg-white border border-[#D0D5DD] rounded-sm. Headers bg-[#EAECF0] border border-[#D0D5DD] p-1.5 font-heading text-xs uppercase. Doc codes and POs in font-data text-xs font-bold.
SupplierShipmentsPage.jsx.status_badges: In Transit: bg-[#FFFAEB] text-[#B54708] border-[#FEDF89] rounded-sm. Discrepancy / Rejected: bg-[#FEF3F2] text-[#B42318] border-[#FECDCA] rounded-sm. Received: bg-[#ECFDF3] text-[#027A48] border-[#ABEFC6] rounded-sm.

SupplierLoginPage.jsx.layout_guideline: Centered login box in max-w-sm w-full bg-white rounded-sm border border-[#D0D5DD] shadow-[0_1px_2px_0_rgba(16,24,40,0.05)] p-8 over bg-[#F2F4F7].
SupplierLoginPage.jsx.branding: Header accent icon in #0E7C86 or #004B87, font-heading title, font-sans inputs with h-9 rounded-sm border-[#D0D5DD] focus:border-[#004B87] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#004B87].
SupplierLoginPage.jsx.submit_button: bg-[#004B87] hover:bg-[#003A6A] active:bg-[#00294D] text-white rounded-sm h-9 text-sm font-bold w-full.

SupplierSignupPage.jsx.purpose: External vendor registration form with GST/PAN upload.
SupplierSignupPage.jsx.layout_guideline: Centered registration box in max-w-lg w-full bg-white rounded-sm border border-[#D0D5DD] shadow-[0_1px_2px_0_rgba(16,24,40,0.05)] p-8 over bg-[#F2F4F7].
SupplierSignupPage.jsx.form_fields: Inputs h-9 text-[13px] rounded-sm border-[#D0D5DD]. File upload dashed targets border border-dashed border-[#D0D5DD] hover:border-[#004B87] rounded-sm. Primary Submit button bg-[#004B87] h-9.

SupplierPendingPage.jsx.purpose: Vendor onboarding status page (pending review or rejected).
SupplierPendingPage.jsx.layout_guideline: Centered status card max-w-md bg-white border border-[#D0D5DD] rounded-sm shadow-[0_1px_2px_0_rgba(16,24,40,0.05)] p-8 text-center over bg-[#F2F4F7]. Button bg-[#004B87] rounded-sm.

grids.style: Dense JDE ERP tabular data grids
grids.columns: Standard 12-column form grids or full-width data tables.

page.structure: Fixed top enterprise header (#0E7C86), compact toolbar/filters (#FFFFFF border-[#D0D5DD]), full-width grid tables.

motion.animations: Minimal. Utilitarian ERP aesthetic without decorative entrance animations.

accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Apply the JDE Enterprise ERP theme consistently across GrnApprovalPage.jsx and all Supplier Portal pages (SupplierDashboardPage.jsx, SupplierShipmentsPage.jsx, SupplierLoginPage.jsx, SupplierSignupPage.jsx, SupplierPendingPage.jsx).
Ensure all page headers match Materials Hub's #0E7C86 Teal Header with font-heading title and font-sans subtitle.
Replace all instances of bright SaaS blue #0076CC with JDE Enterprise Blue #004B87 (hover: #003A6A, active: #00294D).

Update table components to full grid borders (border-collapse w-full text-[13px], thead th with bg-[#EAECF0] border border-[#D0D5DD] p-1.5 font-heading text-xs uppercase text-[#344054], tbody td with border border-[#D0D5DD] px-2 py-1).
Apply zebra striping on table rows (even rows: bg-white, odd rows: bg-[#F9FAFB], hover state: bg-[#F0F4F8]).
Ensure all PO numbers, Document Codes, Vendor Codes, Quantities, Prices, and Dates are styled with font-data (JetBrains Mono).
Maintain strict rounded-sm border-radius on all cards, buttons, inputs, dialogs, and badges. Do not use rounded-full.
Preserve all data-testid attributes on interactive elements to ensure test suite compatibility.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Apply IBM Plex Sans for body text, Chivo for headings, and JetBrains Mono for data/codes.
Use JDE Enterprise ERP palette: Primary #004B87, Header #0E7C86, Page BG #F2F4F7, Table Header #EAECF0, Borders #D0D5DD.
Design dense, information-heavy tables with full grid cell borders (border border-[#D0D5DD]) and sticky headers.
Do NOT use rounded-full or heavy gradients; stick to rounded-sm and shadow-[0_1px_2px_0_rgba(16,24,40,0.05)] for utilitarian ERP aesthetic.
Forms must have clear borders (border-[#D0D5DD]), compact inputs (h-8 or h-9), and clear labels.
Do NOT apply universal transitions (e.g. transition: all).
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes.
